blocks.text: You will hear people speaking in different situations. Match each speaker (1-4) to the place they are at(A-F). There are TWO EXTRA options which you do not need to use. Mark your answers on the answer sheet.
You will hear someone giving a talk. Label the places (19-23) on the map (A-H). There are THREE extra options which you do not need to use. Mark your answers on the answer sheet.
You will hear three extracts. Choose the correct answer (A, B or C) for each question (24-29). There are TWO questions for each extract. Mark your answers on the answer sheet.

Extract One
*You will hear two students, Sam and Liz, discussing their university orientation program.*

items.q: What is this conversation mainly about?
options: A) Their plans for the first week of university.
B) The subjects they will study this semester.
C) The best places to visit near the university.

items.q: In the end, the two students agreed that...?
options: A) Sam will join the ‘Careers Lecture’.
B) they both attend the ‘Uni Tour’.
C) they don’t know what to do in the university.

blocks.text:
Extract Two
*You will hear a student, Eric, talking to his lecturer, Ms Harris, about essay writing.*

items.q: What is Eric mainly talking to Ms Harris about?
options: A) How to improve his advice on issues.
B) How to begin writing his thesis.
C) How to write summaries.

items.q: What advice does Ms Harris give Eric?
options: A) Choose a topic that genuinely interests him
B) Follow the topic suggested by his supervisor
C) Start writing before deciding on a topic

Extract Three
*You will hear an interview with someone whose daughters are appearing in a show in London.*

items.q: When Olivia tried to get a part in Mary Poppins, she
options: A) did not really expect to get the part.
B) was extremely upset not to get the part.
C) was immediately rejected for the part.

items.q: What happened at the first auditions for The Sound of Music?
options: A) There were so many people that the family considered leaving.
B) The family arrived later than they had been told to arrive.
C) Jackie’s was able to persuade judges to see her children.
